blocks.prompt: 11. [printed as 10.] The demand function is \(p = 30 - 2x - x^{2}\) and supply function is \(p = -6 + 4x + x^{2}\). Find consumer's surplus and producer's surplus.
blocks.explanation:
Surplus ke har sawal mein pehla kaam market equilibrium \((x_e, p_e)\) nikalna hai, yani woh point jahan demand aur supply barabar hon.
Us ke baad 3.7.2 ke formulas lagte hain:
\(CS = \int_0^{x_e}(D(x) - p_e)\,dx\) aur \(PS = \int_0^{x_e}(p_e - S(x))\,dx\).
Plan: equilibrium, phir dono areas.
steps:
Diya gaya: demand \(D(x) = 30 - 2x - x^{2}\), supply \(S(x) = -6 + 4x + x^{2}\).
Maloom karna: consumer's surplus (CS) aur producer's surplus (PS).
Tareeqa: pehle equilibrium, phir har curve aur price line \(p = p_e\) ke darmiyan area. CS consumer ki bachat hai (jo woh dene ko tayyar tha minus jo diya), PS producer ka faida hai (jo mila minus jis par woh bechne ko tayyar tha).

Qadam 1: Equilibrium quantity
\[30 - 2x - x^{2} = -6 + 4x + x^{2}\]
\[2x^{2} + 6x - 36 = 0 \Rightarrow x^{2} + 3x - 18 = 0\]
\[(x + 6)(x - 3) = 0 \Rightarrow x_e = 3\]
Kyun: Equilibrium par demand price aur supply price barabar hoti hai, is liye dono functions barabar rakhe. Sab terms ek taraf la kar 2 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(x = -6\) bhi root hai lekin quantity (miqdaar) negative nahi ho sakti, is liye usay chhor dete hain.

Qadam 2: Equilibrium price
\[p_e = D(3) = 30 - 6 - 9 = 15\]
Kyun: \(x_e\) kisi bhi function mein rakh sakte hain; check ke liye \(S(3) = -6 + 12 + 9 = 15\), wohi aaya.

Qadam 3: Consumer's surplus
\[CS = \int_0^{3}(30 - 2x - x^{2} - 15)\,dx\]
\[= \int_0^{3}(15 - 2x - x^{2})\,dx\]
\[= \left[15x - x^{2} - \dfrac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_0^{3} = 45 - 9 - 9 = 27\]
Kyun: CS demand curve ke neeche aur price line \(p = 15\) ke upar wala area hai, \(0\) se \(x_e\) tak. Integrand demand minus price hai.

Qadam 4: Producer's surplus
\[PS = \int_0^{3}(15 + 6 - 4x - x^{2})\,dx\]
\[= \int_0^{3}(21 - 4x - x^{2})\,dx\]
\[= \left[21x - 2x^{2} - \dfrac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_0^{3} = 63 - 18 - 9 = 36\]
Kyun: PS price line \(p = 15\) aur us ke neeche supply curve ke darmiyan area hai. \(15 - (-6 + 4x + x^{2}) = 21 - 4x - x^{2}\).
Dhyan dein: \(S(x)\) ko minus karte waqt bracket ke andar har term ka sign badalna hai; \(-(-6) = +6\) aksar ghalat ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq:
Total surplus \(= \int_0^{3}(D - S)\,dx = \int_0^{3}(36 - 6x - 2x^{2})\,dx = 108 - 27 - 18 = 63\), aur \(27 + 36 = 63\). Dono mil gaye, is liye hisaab sahi hai.

answer_figure.alt: Price p against quantity x. The falling demand curve p = 30 minus 2x minus x squared starts at (0, 30); the rising supply curve p = minus 6 plus 4x plus x squared starts at (0, minus 6). They meet at the equilibrium point (3, 15). The region between the demand curve and the line p = 15 (consumer surplus 27) is shaded blue; the region between the line p = 15 and the supply curve (producer surplus 36) is shaded green.
